story_type: prescribed burn lit from a helicopter
hook: This helicopter set a forest on fire on purpose.
narration: This helicopter set a forest on fire on purpose.
October twenty twenty three, Fishlake National Forest in Utah.
Under it hangs a heli-torch, a tank that drips burning fuel onto the ground below.
This forest holds Pando, one aspen clone of more than forty thousand trees, the largest organism ever found.
Aspens rely on fire to reproduce, and invading conifers were crowding them out.
So the heli-torch flew pass after pass through the smoke.
[short pause] Flames ran up the slope and the smoke climbed over the ridge.
outcome: The prescribed burn was lit, and NASA and Forest Service teams studied it from the ground and the air.
title: Helicopter sets a forest on fire
description:
On Oct. 9, 2023, a heli-torch operator ignited a prescribed burn in Utah's Fishlake National Forest, home of the Pando aspen clone, to help aspen trees regrow. NASA FireSense and the Forest Service's FASMEE studied the burn.

facts.claim: Oct. 9, 2023, heli-torch operator ignited a prescribed burn in Fishlake National Forest, Utah
facts.source_quote: On October 9th, 2023, a heli-torch operator flew over the Fishlake National Forest in Utah, igniting a prescribed burn to assist in the regrowth of the Aspen tree population.
The forest is renowned for the Pando clone, the largest organism ever found, spanning 106 acres and consisting of over 40,000 individual trees.

facts.claim: Aspens rely on fire; conifers crowding them out
facts.source_quote: Aspen trees, classified as pyrophile plants, rely on fire for reproduction. However, the encroachment of conifer trees in Fishlake National Forest has diminished local Aspen populations.

facts.claim: NASA FireSense and Forest Service FASMEE studied the burn, including from the air
facts.source_quote: Organizations such as US Forests Services’s FASMEE and NASA's FireSense participated in studying this burn, with NASA leveraging its unique Earth science and airborne technological capabilities
